description.zh: 待修改的配置项，详情请参见[计算层变量](~~316576~~)。
description.en: The configuration item to modify. For more information, see [Compute layer variables](~~316576~~).
If configName is set to ENABLE_CONSISTENT_REPLICA_READ, the valid values are "true" and "false".

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx modify-db-instance-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --config-name ENABLE_CONSISTENT_REPLICA_READ --config-value true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx ModifyDBInstanceConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigValue true --ConfigName ENABLE_CONSISTENT_REPLICA_READ --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName 'pxc-hzjasd0000'
